shared_questions.text_mode_a: Your partner forgot something you asked them to do for the third time this month. What's your gut reaction?

relationship_satisfaction.note: CSI-4 total is the sum of 4 items (each 0-5), range 0-20. Clinical distress cutoff is typically around 13.5 on the original CSI-4.

love_languages.description: Love language items are tallied across forced-choice and scenario questions. Each option maps to one of the five languages. The language with the highest tally is the primary receiving love language. The giving love language is identified from the dedicated giving question (a24 in Mode A, b12 in Mode B).
love_languages.note: No healthy/at-risk/critical thresholds apply. Love languages are preference-based, not deficit-based. The key insight is mismatch between giving and receiving preferences, and between partners.
